objective: Aislar de forma concluyente el fallo rc=2 del resync de pagos ISCAM 130QRO comparando la sucursal canonica y la relacion real entre Venta_Encabezado y Comanda_Pago en ManagementPro. No modificar datos ni Produccion.

queries.name: join_vnfolio_vs_vndocumento
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Venta_Encabezado v WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN Comanda_Pago cp WITH (NOLOCK) ON cp.Co_Folio=v.Vn_Folio WHERE CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)>='2026-08-01' AND CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)<'2026-09-01') AS join_vnfolio, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Venta_Encabezado v WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN Comanda_Pago cp WITH (NOLOCK) ON cp.Co_Folio=v.Vn_Documento WHERE CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)>='2026-08-01' AND CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)<'2026-09-01') AS join_vndocumento

queries.name: payments_by_branch_vndocumento
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (20) CONVERT(varchar(40),v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal) AS sucursal, COUNT(*) AS pagos, CAST(SUM(cp.Cp_Importe) AS decimal(18,2)) AS importe FROM Venta_Encabezado v WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN Comanda_Pago cp WITH (NOLOCK) ON cp.Co_Folio=v.Vn_Documento WHERE CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)>='2026-08-01' AND CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)<'2026-09-01' AND cp.Cp_Importe>0 GROUP BY v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal ORDER BY pagos DESC

queries.name: sample_payment_relation
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (20) v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal,CONVERT(varchar(40),v.Vn_Folio) AS Vn_Folio,CONVERT(varchar(40),v.Vn_Documento) AS Vn_Documento,CONVERT(varchar(40),cp.Co_Folio) AS Cp_Co_Folio,CONVERT(varchar(40),cp.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago) AS forma,cp.Cp_Importe,cp.Cp_Propina,cp.Cp_Comision FROM Venta_Encabezado v WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN Comanda_Pago cp WITH (NOLOCK) ON cp.Co_Folio=v.Vn_Documento WHERE CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)>='2026-08-01' AND CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)<'2026-09-01' AND cp.Cp_Importe>0 ORDER BY v.Vn_Fecha
